changelog:
Initial release of the review-plan skill for pre-execution plan reviews.

- Reviews implementation plans for parallelization, TDD, types, library usage, and security.
- Enforces strict source quoting and anti-confabulation to ensure only plan artifacts are judged.
- Uses a hard-gate sequence—no review proceeds unless prior checks (file access, skill loads, captured outputs) pass.
- Runs five distinct review lenses in parallel or sequentially: Parallelization, TDD, Type/API, Library Best Practices, Security.
- Loads relevant code review skills dynamically based on detected tech stack.
- Synthesizes a consolidated report with summary and critical issues table.
summary: Review implementation plans for parallelization, TDD, types, libraries, and security before execution
